title: Mouse Without Borders does not work after Settings workaround

The original diagnostic archive was rejected for an oversized entry, so no service, pairing, or configuration evidence is available.

The reporter states that disabling CET for PowerToys.MouseWithoutBorders.exe changes the result.
Automated triage could not safely analyze the supplied archive because it contained an oversized entry.
No linked fix, confirmed duplicate, assignee, or sufficiently detailed reproduction was found.
judgment.recommended_action: Request the exact exploit-protection setting and a controlled fresh diagnostic captured with the normal setting restored.

fix_assessment.rationale: A PowerToys code change is not supportable while key generation, device discovery, service startup, and CET mitigation behavior remain unresolved alternatives.

issue_context.summary: Mouse Without Borders cannot create a new key or show devices after a Settings-related workaround; the reporter reports that changing a CET setting for the module executable affects the outcome.
known_information: The issue reports both an ineffective New Key action and an empty device list.
The reporter explicitly identifies CET for PowerToys.MouseWithoutBorders.exe as relevant.
The first diagnostic ZIP could not be analyzed because it had an oversized entry.
inferences: The mitigation setting may affect module startup or runtime behavior, but it is not yet established whether it resolves both pairing symptoms.
A fresh, normally generated diagnostic can distinguish a module startup/configuration failure from a pairing workflow failure.

A clean diagnostic captured after reproducing with the normal setting restores the missing module/service evidence without presuming CET is the root cause.

comment.body: Thanks for identifying that the CET setting for PowerToys.MouseWithoutBorders.exe changes the result. Please provide the exact Exploit Protection Program setting and its before-and-after values, and confirm whether it fixes both the New Key action and the empty device list. Then restore the normal setting, reproduce both symptoms once, and add a comment containing `/bugreport` immediately afterward. The previous archive could not be analyzed, so this will let us distinguish module startup from the pairing workflow.
